name: configure
description: Apply a partial remote-access configure (remote-browser-client plan Â§8.4): any of { enabled, bindAddress, port } set â†’ written to the profile pref and the listener started/stopped to match; absent keys are unchanged. Returns the same status snapshot as getStatus, as of now: the bind is asynchronous, so a configure that begins one returns state 'starting' and the outcome ('listening' or 'error') arrives via onStatusChanged; re-sending an unchanged configure is a no-op that returns the current state. bindAddress must be one of the machine's current IPv4 literals (never 0.0.0.0); a port already in use surfaces as state 'error' + error 'port_in_use' â€” the listener never silently switches ports.

inputs.name: enabled
inputs.description: Master switch. Default unchanged. When false the listener stops (clients closed 4003) and the LNA grant for the guest origin is revoked.

inputs.name: bindAddress
inputs.description: The single IPv4 literal to bind. Must currently appear in net::GetNetworkList (127.0.0.1 accepted for local debugging; 0.0.0.0 / :: rejected). Empty/absent-from-list â†’ state 'error' + error 'no_address'.

inputs.name: port
inputs.description: The listener port. 1024â€“65535 pins a fixed port (a port in use â†’ state 'error' + error 'port_in_use'; never auto-switched). 0 requests an OS-assigned ephemeral port; the ACTUAL bound port is echoed back in the returned status.port (and getStatus / onStatusChanged).
